narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four thousand seventy five starts with an even digit, so it divides by two.
<bookmark mark='box'/>The four thousand part divides by two whatever the digit is.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The first digit tells us nothing here. Only what is left outside the boxes matters.
